fact: The PAENS health component's 2024 work plan states that the Dossier Patient Partagé is in a pilot and testing phase to be supported in 2024 with IT equipment, digital patient cards, bandwidth and user training, and that unique patient identification is not yet settled: the ministry is to convene the actors in a workshop to finalise a first draft of the identification algorithm.
title: Digitalisation de certains systèmes et services de santé
publisher: Projet d'Accélération de l'Économie Numérique au Sénégal (PAENS)
